title: Cohomological Rejuvenation: Tissues That Heal Their Own Incoherence
description: A falsifiable framework separating local tissue mismatch under learned cellular-sheaf compatibility maps from cycle-level cohomological obstruction. Includes reproducible finite-dimensional checks and a proposed donor-held-out analysis of spatial aging data. This release reports no analysis of a biological atlas and no biological intervention result.
